newsitem.title: USA: Amex says April options volume sets record.
newsitem.headline: Amex says April options volume sets record.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Thursday that options volume for the month of April was the heaviest in exchange history.
Combined volume for both equity and index options hit a new all-time high of 7,312,966 contracts. The previous monthly record, set in October, 1987, was 7,266,071 contracts.
Combined options volume last month was 38.3 percent higher than in April 1996, when volume totaled 5,286,355 contracts.
Equity options volume also set a new record in April, with 6,877,990 contracts changing hands. The previous record, set in January 1997, was 6,825,081.
Index options volume for April was 434,976.
